<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 520 380" width="520" height="380">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="520" height="380" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Graph axes -->
  <!-- Vertical axis -->
  <line x1="60" y1="30" x2="60" y2="280" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <!-- Horizontal axis -->
  <line x1="60" y1="280" x2="480" y2="280" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Axis arrows -->
  <!-- Vertical arrow -->
  <polygon points="60,22 56,30 64,30" fill="#000000" />
  <!-- Horizontal arrow -->
  <polygon points="488,280 480,276 480,284" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- Axis labels -->
  <!-- Vertical axis label -->
  <text x="60" y="16" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle">Number of</text>
  <text x="60" y="30" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle"></text> <!-- spacing holder -->
  <!-- Let's adjust vertical label to be neat -->
  <g transform="translate(42, 110) rotate(-90)">
    <text x="0" y="0" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">Number of molecules</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Horizontal axis label -->
  <text x="270" y="310" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">Kinetic energy</text>

  <!-- Activation energy line and label -->
  <!-- Ea line well to the right of peaks -->
  <line x1="360" y1="70" x2="360" y2="280" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="5,5" />
  <text x="360" y="295" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="13" font-style="italic" text-anchor="middle">E</text>
  <text x="367" y="298" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="10" text-anchor="start">a</text>

  <!-- Curve T1: Solid curve, tall, narrow peak -->
  <!-- Path starts at origin (60, 280), peaks around x=140, y=80, crosses T2, and has a shorter tail -->
  <path d="M 60 280 C 100 280, 110 90, 145 90 C 180 90, 220 230, 280 270 C 330 278, 400 279.5, 460 280" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Curve T2: Dashed curve, lower peak, further right, longer tail -->
  <!-- Path starts at origin (60, 280), peaks around x=190, y=140, crosses T1, and has a higher tail -->
  <path d="M 60 280 C 120 280, 150 140, 200 140 C 250 140, 275 190, 310 235 C 360 260, 410 273, 470 280" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />

  <!-- Curve labels -->
  <!-- T1 label pointing to or placed near solid curve -->
  <text x="130" y="70" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="13" font-style="italic">T</text>
  <text x="137" y="73" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="10">1</text>

  <!-- T2 label pointing to or placed near dashed curve -->
  <text x="215" y="123" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="13" font-style="italic">T</text>
  <text x="222" y="126" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="10">2</text>

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="260" y="350" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 5.1</text>
</svg>
